title: Text: DET Nick Castellanos ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Wasn’t feeling too hot last few days, so I didn’t wanna drive 8 hrs. If you have any kind of background info you want to pass on about Lloyd, let me know ... Guys he’s helped, his impact, teachings, etc. I’m working on a story in defense of him. I have a feeling they’re gonna make him a scapegoat. No quotes, attribution, just looking for some material to ask him about.
Unless you have a star studded offense like we had in 2012-16 no hitting coach is going to succeed in breading young kids at that field in that environment.
I saw something that Detroit was top 5 in launch angle or something but were last in homeruns...
